explains: The body of the void action of InvoiceViewSet in billing/api.py changes (it is the method InvoiceViewSet.void, decorated with @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])). The viewset is registered on a DefaultRouter in billing/api_urls.py: router.register(r"invoices", api.InvoiceViewSet, basename="invoice"), and the router's urls are included at the empty path of that URLconf, which config/urls.py includes under api/v1/. The router makes the routes of a viewset from its actions: the list and detail routes from the list and retrieve actions of the mixins, and one route per @action. A change inside one method reaches the route of that method only. This is a detail action, so the path is invoices/{pk}/void, and the method is POST: POST /api/v1/invoices/{pk}/void, with the decorator line, the register line, the include of the router and the include in config/urls.py as evidence. The overdue action, the list and the detail routes, and the API root view are not reached. The web client does not call this route.

must_exclude.why: another action of the same viewset
the list route of the viewset: the change is in one method
the detail route of the viewset: the change is in one method
the API root view of the router
